question: How many customers are there?
ai_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer;

question: Which countries do customers come from?
ai_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Country;

question: How many tracks are in the database?
ai_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track;

question: List all genres.
ai_sql: SELECT GenreId, Name FROM Genre;

question: What is the total sales revenue?
ai_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalSalesRevenue FROM Invoice;

question: Top 5 countries by revenue
ai_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS Country, SUM(Total) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 5 artists by revenue
ai_sql:
WITH artist_revenue AS (
SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
ranked AS (
SELECT ArtistId, Name, Revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Revenue DESC) AS rnk
FROM artist_revenue
)
SELECT Name, Revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY Revenue DESC

question: Which album has the most tracks?
ai_sql: SELECT a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId));

question: Revenue by year
ai_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;

question: Average invoice amount per country
ai_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry;

question: Number of tracks per genre
ai_sql: SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre g LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;

question: Which sales rep generated the most revenue?
ai_sql:
WITH rep_revenue AS (
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS Revenue
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
),
ranked AS (
SELECT EmployeeId, FirstName, LastName, Revenue,
RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Revenue DESC) AS rnk
FROM rep_revenue
)
SELECT EmployeeId, FirstName, LastName, Revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;

question: Customers who spent more than $45 in total
ai_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC;

question: Longest track, in minutes
ai_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS Minutes FROM (SELECT Name, Milliseconds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC) AS rnk FROM Track) WHERE rnk = 1;

question: Top genre in each country by revenue
ai_sql:
WITH genre_rev AS (
SELECT i.BillingCountry AS Country, g.Name AS Genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY i.BillingCountry, g.Name
),
ranked AS (
SELECT Country, Genre, Revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY Revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM genre_rev
)
SELECT Country, Genre, Revenue FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY Country;

question: Month-over-month revenue change in the latest year
ai_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY month
),
with_change AS (
  SELECT month,
         revenue,
         revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change,
         ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_pct
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(mom_change, 2) AS mom_change,
       mom_pct
FROM with_change
WHERE substr(month, 1, 4) = (SELECT strftime('%Y', MAX(InvoiceDate)) FROM Invoice)
ORDER BY month;

question: Customers who never bought a Rock track
ai_sql:
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email
FROM Customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
      AND g.Name = 'Rock'
);

question: Each sales rep's percentage share of total revenue
ai_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS SalesRep, SUM(i.Total) AS Revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.Total) / (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice), 2) AS PercentShare FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

question: Customers who made a purchase in every year
ai_sql: WITH all_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS y FROM Invoice), cust_years AS (SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)) AS yc FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN cust_years cy ON c.CustomerId = cy.CustomerId WHERE cy.yc = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_years);

question: Who are our best customers?
ai_sql:
WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           c.FirstName,
           c.LastName,
           c.Email,
           SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC) AS SpendRank
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Email, ROUND(TotalSpent, 2) AS TotalSpent, SpendRank
FROM ranked
WHERE SpendRank <= 10
ORDER BY SpendRank, LastName, FirstName;
